messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD Alert - model-catalog-config - prod-eu (severity: P1). Auto-escalation +2. Rule: catalog-defaults-mismatch. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
Leah R: acked. I'm on it. Leaving a quick note: any impacting customers?
customer-success-bot: Support flagged two EU customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: nordhealth) reporting tokenization failures/empty responses since ~09:00 UTC. CS ticket #CS-2987 opened.
Michael C: seeing the same in runtime logs: payloads get tokenizer error then connection drop. Example log: `runtime: decode_error: tokenizer "tokenizer_v2" not found for model rev rev-2026-04-12`
Leah R: thanks. hypothesis: catalog promotion pushed an incompatible tokenizer/defaults for the new model rev in prod-eu region. This triggered automatic routing to the new revision.
Anjali S: looping in SRE lead. Quick mitigation options: 1) pin routing to previous rev 2) temporarily fallback to hosted-compat model 3) suppress duplicate pages after pin
Leah R: Michael, can you pin the catalog entry to last-known-good rev for prod-eu?
Michael C: doing now. Running pin command: ```
# pin model in catalog for prod-eu
rwctl catalog pin --model-id=redwood-13b --env=prod-eu --rev=rev-2026-03-30 --reason "emergency revert: tokenizer mismatch causing decode errors"
```
Michael C: pin completed, catalog API returned 200. Verifying routing...
Michael C: routing table updated, traffic draining from rev-2026-04-12 -> rev-2026-03-30. TTL for drain: 60s.
Leah R: monitor logs for 2 mins, then ask CS to confirm customer impact gone.
customer-success-bot: Notified accounts and updated CS tickets. They will test send requests in ~3m.
Timothy H: I'm going to open a temporary PD suppression rule for the specific alert fingerprint to avoid noisy escalations while we observe. Command: `pdctl suppression create --service model-catalog --fingerprint "catalog-defaults-mismatch|prod-eu" --duration 15m`
Timothy H: suppression created. PD will still record but won't escalate to next oncall.
Anjali S: while pin is active, let's create a rollback PR to revert the bad defaults and add a safety test. I'll start PR and link it to infra issue.
Anjali S: PR: https://git.example/rw/catalog/compare/revert-2026-04-12-defaults (WIP)
Michael C: initial checks: prod-eu 502/empty responses for acme-inc are cleared on our end. logs show successful tokenization with tokenizer_v1.
Leah R: CS confirms acme-inc test passed. nordhealth still running a longer workflow but CS says their first endpoint test returned payload.
Anjali S: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-9876: "catalog promotion safety: require tokenizer compatibility check + automated rollback guard"
Anjali S: assigning to eng-ml + eng-runtime, priority P0 for morning follow-up.
Leah R: handoff: I'm staying for 10 more mins then handing to SRE-Rotation for verification and any followups. Please capture actions in the incident doc.
SRE-Rotation: taking over at 09:25 UTC. I'll watch for regressions and ensure pins persist through autosync.
Timothy H: I've attached a temporary alert annotated note in PD: "mitigated via pin; do not re-escalate; action: revert defaults + add test"
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigated -> partial. Creating incident record: https://incidents.example/INC12345. Add timeline and postmortem template created.
Leah R: quick postmortem notes: root cause likely automated promotion pipeline omitted tokenizer_compat check. Impact: 2 customers intermittent decode failures in prod-eu for ~6m window. Mitigation: catalog pin, PD suppression, rollback PR. Next actions: (1) revert defaults (PR) (2) add pre-promotion compatibility test (3) add automated canary gating and alert to release engineer.
Anjali S: I've scheduled a 30-min incident sync with eng-ml and runtime in 40m to finalize fixes and timeline.
Michael C: adding logs/commands to incident record and uploading catalog diff.
Leah R: closing thread for paging; leave open for postmortem edits. If anything re-triggers, I'll reopen PD. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved: PD Alert - model-catalog-config - prod-eu. Closed by Leah R at 09:24:11 UTC.
